test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to rectify it, select ‘no rectification needed’.

His claim to be the __smartly __kid in the school was a bit hyperbole!
solution:
The correct answer is o**ption 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The phrase "the smartly kid" is grammatically incorrect.**
 
• Here**, "smartest" i**s the superlative form of the adjective** "smart."**
 
• The superlative form is used when comparing three or more items, in this case, the student to the rest of the school.
